assertions.description: DOMParser honours default and prefixed namespaces (engine-swap invariant).
assertions.test: (()=>{ const P = new DOMParser(); return P.parseFromString('<r xmlns="urn:a"/>', 'application/xml').documentElement.namespaceURI === 'urn:a' && P.parseFromString('<r xmlns:p="urn:b"><p:c/></r>', 'application/xml').getElementsByTagNameNS('urn:b', 'c').length === 1; })()

assertions.description: CDATA stays literal; predefined entities and character references expand.
assertions.test: (()=>{ const P = new DOMParser(); return P.parseFromString('<r><![CDATA[<x> & y]]></r>', 'application/xml').documentElement.textContent === '<x> & y' && P.parseFromString('<r>&AB</r>', 'application/xml').documentElement.textContent === '&AB'; })()
(()=> new DOMParser().parseFromString('<r>  a \n b  </r>', 'application/xml').documentElement.textContent === '  a \n b  ')()

assertions.description: Malformed XML never throws: parseFromString returns a document containing a parsererror element (namespace varies by engine: Mozilla error namespace in Firefox, XHTML in WebKit/Chrome — the check matches the local name in any namespace).
assertions.test: (()=>{ try { const d = new DOMParser().parseFromString('<r><broken></r>', 'application/xml'); return !!d.querySelector('parsererror') || d.getElementsByTagNameNS('http://www.mozilla.org/newlayout/xml/parsererror.xml', 'parsererror').length > 0; } catch (e) { return false; } })()

assertions.description: XMLHttpRequest with an XML response yields a parsed Document via responseXML/response (a swapped surface).
assertions.test: (async()=>{ const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob(['<feed><item id="1"/></feed>'], { type: 'application/xml' })); try { const doc = await new Promise((res, rej) => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', url); x.responseType = 'document'; x.onload = () => res(x.responseXML ?? x.response); x.onerror = () => rej(new Error('xhr failed')); x.send(); }); return !!doc && doc.documentElement.nodeName === 'feed' && !!doc.querySelector('item[id="1"]'); } catch (e) { return false; } finally { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); } })()

assertions.description: image/svg+xml parsing produces a real SVG-namespace root element (a swapped surface).
assertions.test: (()=>{ const d = new DOMParser().parseFromString('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"/>', 'image/svg+xml'); return d.documentElement.namespaceURI === 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'; })()

assertions.description: XSLTProcessor (deliberately excluded from this migration) keeps working: a one-template transform produces the expected output document.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof XSLTProcessor === 'undefined') return false; try { const P = new DOMParser(); const xslt = P.parseFromString('<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform"><xsl:template match="/"><out><xsl:value-of select="/in"/></out></xsl:template></xsl:stylesheet>', 'application/xml'); const src = P.parseFromString('<in>hi</in>', 'application/xml'); const proc = new XSLTProcessor(); proc.importStylesheet(xslt); const res = proc.transformToDocument(src); return res.documentElement.nodeName === 'out' && res.documentElement.textContent === 'hi'; } catch (e) { return false; } })()
